User value is Unverified. Official submission: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/#process . Official three-minute guide: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/student-preparation.pdf .
0:55–2:00. The current shop example requests a navy waterproof daypack of about 20 litres, any brand, in Mapo for evening pickup. A bounded real API interview prepared stock, price and closing/pickup questions; six provider responses, two customer turns. The price question says available before stock is confirmed, a disclosed wording limitation. No stock, price or hours are established. The actual shop room accepted at 15:12:16 KST and received the full Korean opening and stock question. The operator ended at 15:15:45 after unsupported stock/price classification and a microphone stall. Human audibility is not confirmed. Source: artifacts/v2/live-shop-first-attempt.json. Ask conditionally whether black would be acceptable; never assume the preference. Source: artifacts/v2/live-shop-plan-check.json; docs/v2-shop-demo.md. Open a separate business tab on the same laptop. It must remain inactive before customer authorization. Accept only when incoming. Use fictional customer details and business answers. Choose an unknown customer detail based on the actual interview, rather than assuming prior-visit status is unknown. The third actual rehearsal captured four business answers and a readback, but confirmation reset the answers and the teammate disconnected. Unknown-detail relay and a normal completed call remain unverified. Demonstrate these steps only if a new real run actually reaches them.

Team-defined YOKOBU v2 scope, including the later instruction to use separate tabs on this laptop instead of two actual phones. No real telephone calls or real institution search. User value is Unverified. Official submission: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/#process . Official three-minute guide: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/student-preparation.pdf .
2:00–2:30. The current code checkpoint has 63 local tests (31 state, 17 guard, 15 legacy), 23 actual local HTTP checks with synthetic setup plans and upstream network blocked, 20 mocked customer browser checks, and 14 mocked business browser checks. These are different evidence classes. The third real laptop microphone run captured four actual Korean business answers and an assistant readback, including qualified cost uncertainty. Business confirmation incorrectly reset the resolved state; the human disconnected. Korean audibility was human-confirmed in the first attempt only. Unknown-detail relay was not exercised in the third attempt. Later readback and startup fixes require another live rehearsal. Startup now waits for session.created, a remote track and connection registration, sends one tool-free opening, and pauses the microphone through completed playback and playback permission; missing opening audio fails after 12 seconds. The new shop opening audio started at 15:12:19.502 and its full greeting/stock-question transcript was captured, but human audibility is not confirmed. Only a business greeting and apology were transcribed. The review incorrectly classified those as negative stock and unavailable price; that unsupported state also entered the summary. Consecutive responses left the microphone paused; the operator ended at 15:15:45. Repairs are pending, and no live relay or normal completion is claimed. Source: artifacts/v2/live-shop-first-attempt.json. A separate recorded-text summary regression passed 9/9 using one real structured recommendation request. The AI chose an allowed action and existing answer references; rendering preserved the original interrupted outcome and qualified price, without new microphone or audio evidence. Source: artifacts/v2/recorded-third-typed-summary-check.json. Real Russian and Chinese interviews were exercised, but Korean question fidelity and unsupported first-visit wording remain limited. Sources: artifacts/v2/live-native-rehearsal-third-attempt.json; artifacts/v2/live-native-third-attempt-audit.json; artifacts/v2/customer-ui-check.json; docs/v2-verification.md. These local evidence files are not raw material for the official upload.
